Attributed source prerequisite restatement:
E is a finite-dimensional real inner-product space equipped with its Borel measurable space, including dimension zero. V:E->R is globally C2. alpha>0, eta>0, and for every x,v, alpha norm(v)^2<=D2V(x)[v,v]. The source upper Hessian bound and eta upper cap are not required for this normalization/regularity adapter.
Z_V=integral exp(-V(x))dx, mu=volume.tilted(-V), C_eta=(sqrt(2*pi*eta))^(-dim E), A_eta(y)=C_eta integral exp(-V(x)-norm(y-x)^2/(2eta))dx, and the SOURCE potential is V_eta(y)=-log A_eta(y). These are actual functions and measures, not supplied normalized Gibbs certificates.
Original Gibbs integrability, positive Z_V, mu probability, actual Gaussian add-noise density, integrable A_eta and preserved partition are derived. The normalized probability-density potential is U_eta=-log(C_eta integral exp(-norm(y-x)^2/(2eta))dmu(x)); the exact identity U_eta=V_eta+log Z_V is a conclusion. No moments, minimizer, input law, conditional representative, smoothed regularity or smoothed Hessian certificate is passed.
The original Gibbs mass Z_V is strictly positive and mu is a probability measure. The actual Gaussian add-noise law equals volume.withDensity(ofReal(exp(-V_eta)/Z_V)). The source unnormalized weight A_eta is integrable with integral exactly Z_V, so this same law is volume.tilted(-V_eta). A_eta is positive everywhere, V_eta is globally C2, and at every y the normalized negative-log density U_eta(y)=V_eta(y)+log Z_V.
Actual source unnormalized smoothed potential V_eta, positive finite partition Z_V preserved by smoothing, genuine original and smoothed Gibbs probability laws, normalized U_eta=V_eta+log Z_V and source V_eta C2. No posterior score/covariance, curvature/higher derivative inequalities, exact-flow stationarity, numerical accuracy/stochastic errors/history/work, PBPS process or either complete main/composition. TV never transfers unbounded expected cost.

{V : E → ℝ} {α η : ℝ} (hα : 0 < α) (hV : ContDiff ℝ 2 V)
    (hH : ∀ x v : E, α*‖v‖^2 ≤ fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v v) (hη : 0 < η) :
    let ZV := ∫ x, Real.exp (-V x) ∂(volume : Measure E)
    let μ := (volume : Measure E).tilted (fun x => -V x)
    let C := ((Real.sqrt (2*Real.pi*η))⁻¹)^Module.finrank ℝ E
    let A := fun y : E => C*∫ x, Real.exp (-V x-‖y-x‖^2/(2*η)) ∂(volume : Measure E)
    0 < ZV ∧ IsProbabilityMeasure μ ∧
      (μ.prod (stdGaussian E)).map (fun p => p.1+Real.sqrt η • p.2) =
        (volume : Measure E).withDensity
          (fun y => ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(-Real.log (A y)))/ZV)) ∧
      Integrable A (volume : Measure E) ∧
      (∫ y, A y ∂(volume : Measure E)) = ZV ∧
      (μ.prod (stdGaussian E)).map (fun p => p.1+Real.sqrt η • p.2) =
        (volume : Measure E).tilted (fun y => -(-Real.log (A y))) ∧
      (∀ y, 0 < A y) ∧
      ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun y => -Real.log (A y)) ∧
      ∀ y, -Real.log (C*∫ x, Real.exp (-‖y-x‖^2/(2*η)) ∂μ) =
        -Real.log (A y)+Real.log ZV

V:E->R is C2. alpha and eta are strictly positive reals; the displayed lower Hessian inequality holds for every x and v. fderiv R(fderiv R V)x v v is the second Frechet derivative applied twice to v.

volume is canonical Lebesgue measure on E. A real integral is the Bochner integral. volume.tilted(-V) means withDensity(ofReal(exp(-V)/integral exp(-V))). Measure.prod means independent product and Measure.map is measurable pushforward. stdGaussian E is centered identity-covariance Gaussian.

Real.exp/log are real exponential/logarithm, ENNReal.ofReal is the nonnegative density coercion, ContDiff R 2 means globally twice continuously Frechet differentiable. All local let expressions define the actual displayed integrals and functions, including the unnormalized negative-log convolution and normalized negative-log probability density.

import AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Analysis.StrongConvexGibbsIntegrability

/-!
# The actual source smoothed Gibbs potential

Chen, Chewi, Lu and Zhang, arXiv:2609.06906v1, equation1.1 and Section3.1:
<https://arxiv.org/html/2609.06906v1#S3.SS1>.
The source defines the UNNORMALIZED convolution exp(-V_eta). Its partition is
derived to equal the original positive Z_V, and the actual Gaussian add-noise
law is the Gibbs law of this source potential. The normalized negative-log
density differs by log Z_V; no literal equality of the two potentials is used.
Only the genuine positive lower Hessian and source C2 are required. The source
upper Hessian and eta cap are not needed, including the zero-dimensional case.
Score/covariance, curvature/higher estimates, stationarity, accuracy, query work
and both main/composition results remain separate.
-/

namespace AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.SmoothedPicardHMC.SmoothedGibbsPotential

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
noncomputable section
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
  [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]

/-- The actual source unnormalized smoothed Gibbs potential has preserved
partition and genuine smoothed Gibbs law. Regularity and normalization are
derived from the original Hessian hypotheses, not supplied certificates. -/
theorem smoothed_gibbs_potential {V : E → ℝ} {α η : ℝ} (hα : 0 < α) (hV : ContDiff ℝ 2 V)
    (hH : ∀ x v : E, α*‖v‖^2 ≤ fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v v) (hη : 0 < η) :
    let ZV := ∫ x, Real.exp (-V x) ∂(volume : Measure E)
    let μ := (volume : Measure E).tilted (fun x => -V x)
    let C := ((Real.sqrt (2*Real.pi*η))⁻¹)^Module.finrank ℝ E
    let A := fun y : E => C*∫ x, Real.exp (-V x-‖y-x‖^2/(2*η)) ∂(volume : Measure E)
    0 < ZV ∧ IsProbabilityMeasure μ ∧
      (μ.prod (stdGaussian E)).map (fun p => p.1+Real.sqrt η • p.2) =
        (volume : Measure E).withDensity
          (fun y => ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(-Real.log (A y)))/ZV)) ∧
      Integrable A (volume : Measure E) ∧
      (∫ y, A y ∂(volume : Measure E)) = ZV ∧
      (μ.prod (stdGaussian E)).map (fun p => p.1+Real.sqrt η • p.2) =
        (volume : Measure E).tilted (fun y => -(-Real.log (A y))) ∧
      (∀ y, 0 < A y) ∧
      ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun y => -Real.log (A y)) ∧
      ∀ y, -Real.log (C*∫ x, Real.exp (-‖y-x‖^2/(2*η)) ∂μ) =
        -Real.log (A y)+Real.log ZV := by
  let ZV := ∫ x, Real.exp (-V x) ∂(volume : Measure E)
  let μ := (volume : Measure E).tilted (fun x => -V x)
  let C := ((Real.sqrt (2*Real.pi*η))⁻¹)^Module.finrank ℝ E
  let A := fun y : E => C*∫ x, Real.exp (-V x-‖y-x‖^2/(2*η)) ∂(volume : Measure E)
  have hi := AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Analysis.StrongConvexGibbsIntegrability.integrable_exp_neg_of_strongConvexOn
    hα (hV.differentiable (by norm_num))
    (AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Analysis.HessianStrongConvexity.strongConvexOn_univ_of_fderiv2_lower hV hH)
  have hZ : 0 < ZV := integral_exp_pos hi
  have : IsProbabilityMeasure μ := isProbabilityMeasure_tilted hi
  have hc := AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Measure.GaussianConvolutionRegularity.gaussian_convolution_potential_c2 μ hη
  have he (y : E) : C*∫ x, Real.exp (-‖y-x‖^2/(2*η)) ∂μ = A y/ZV := by
    rw [show μ = (volume : Measure E).tilted (fun x => -V x) from rfl,integral_tilted]
    dsimp only [A,ZV]
    rw [show (C*∫ x, Real.exp (-V x-‖y-x‖^2/(2*η)) ∂(volume : Measure E))/
        (∫ x, Real.exp (-V x) ∂(volume : Measure E)) =
      C*((∫ x, Real.exp (-V x-‖y-x‖^2/(2*η)) ∂(volume : Measure E))/
        (∫ x, Real.exp (-V x) ∂(volume : Measure E))) by ring]
    congr 1
    rw [← integral_div]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards with x
    rw [smul_eq_mul,show Real.exp (-V x-‖y-x‖^2/(2*η)) =
      Real.exp (-V x)*Real.exp (-‖y-x‖^2/(2*η)) by
        rw [show -V x-‖y-x‖^2/(2*η) = -V x+(-‖y-x‖^2/(2*η)) by ring,Real.exp_add]]
    ring
  have hA (y : E) : 0 < A y :=
    (div_pos_iff_of_pos_right hZ).mp (he y ▸ hc.2.1 y)
  have hv (y : E) : -Real.log (C*∫ x, Real.exp (-‖y-x‖^2/(2*η)) ∂μ) =
      -Real.log (A y)+Real.log ZV := by
    rw [he,Real.log_div (hA y).ne' hZ.ne']; ring
  have hlaw : (μ.prod (stdGaussian E)).map (fun p => p.1+Real.sqrt η • p.2) =
      (volume : Measure E).withDensity (fun y => ENNReal.ofReal (A y/ZV)) := by
    convert hc.1 using 1
    congr 1
    funext y
    exact congrArg ENNReal.ofReal (he y).symm
  have hDcont : Continuous (fun y => A y/ZV) := by
    have hefun : (fun y => A y/ZV) =
        (fun y => C*∫ x, Real.exp (-‖y-x‖^2/(2*η)) ∂μ) :=
      funext (fun y => (he y).symm)
    rw [hefun]
    exact continuous_const.mul hc.2.2.1.continuous
  have hnonneg : ∀ y, 0 ≤ A y/ZV := fun y => (div_pos (hA y) hZ).le
  have : IsProbabilityMeasure ((μ.prod (stdGaussian E)).map
      (fun p => p.1+Real.sqrt η • p.2)) := Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map (by fun_prop)
  have hm : ∫⁻ y, ENNReal.ofReal (A y/ZV) ∂(volume : Measure E) = 1 := by
    have hm := (congrArg (fun m : Measure E => m Set.univ) hlaw).symm
    simpa only [withDensity_apply _ MeasurableSet.univ,setLIntegral_univ,
      measure_univ] using hm
  have hiD : Integrable (fun y => A y/ZV) (volume : Measure E) :=
    (lintegral_ofReal_ne_top_iff_integrable hDcont.aestronglyMeasurable
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hnonneg)).mp (by rw [hm]; exact ENNReal.one_ne_top)
  have hIntD : (∫ y, A y/ZV ∂(volume : Measure E)) = 1 := by
    have hp := ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hiD (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hnonneg)
    rw [hm] at hp
    have ht := congrArg ENNReal.toReal hp
    simpa only [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (integral_nonneg hnonneg),ENNReal.toReal_one] using ht
  have hiA : Integrable A (volume : Measure E) := by
    convert hiD.mul_const ZV using 1
    funext y
    exact (div_mul_cancel₀ (A y) hZ.ne').symm
  have hIntA : (∫ y, A y ∂(volume : Measure E)) = ZV := by
    rw [integral_div] at hIntD
    simpa only [one_mul] using (div_eq_iff hZ.ne').mp hIntD
  have hTilt : (μ.prod (stdGaussian E)).map (fun p => p.1+Real.sqrt η • p.2) =
      (volume : Measure E).tilted (fun y => -(-Real.log (A y))) := by
    rw [Measure.tilted]
    simp_rw [neg_neg,Real.exp_log (hA _)]
    rw [hIntA]
    exact hlaw
  refine ⟨hZ,inferInstance,?_,hiA,hIntA,hTilt,hA,?_,hv⟩
  · change (μ.prod (stdGaussian E)).map (fun p => p.1+Real.sqrt η • p.2) =
      (volume : Measure E).withDensity (fun y => ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(-Real.log (A y)))/ZV))
    convert hlaw using 1
    congr 1
    funext y
    rw [neg_neg,Real.exp_log (hA y)]
  have hg : (fun y => -Real.log (A y)) =
      (fun y => -Real.log (C*∫ x, Real.exp (-‖y-x‖^2/(2*η)) ∂μ)-Real.log ZV) := by
    funext y; rw [hv]; ring
  rw [hg]
  exact hc.2.2.2.sub contDiff_const

end
end AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.SmoothedPicardHMC.SmoothedGibbsPotential

steps.title: Derive the original Gibbs probability
steps.text: The genuine lower Hessian produces strong convexity of V; the existing Gibbs-integrability producer yields integrable exp(-V) without a minimizer premise. The positive exponential integral gives Z_V>0, and the exact exponential tilt is therefore a probability measure.

steps.title: Use the actual Gaussian density and regularity producer
steps.text: Apply the independently admitted shared arbitrary-probability Gaussian result to this derived mu. It identifies the true pushforward law, gives positive density and C2 of the normalizer and normalized negative-log density. These facts concern the actual two independent variables x and standard Gaussian g.

steps.title: Connect the source unnormalized convolution exactly
steps.text: The tilted Bochner-integral identity inserts the actual original Gibbs density. Exponential additivity and moving the fixed Z_V outside the integral yield C_eta Z_mu=A_eta/Z_V at every observation, with the exact Gaussian prefactor retained. Positivity of this density and Z_V gives A_eta>0 everywhere.
steps.lean: integral_tilted; Real.exp_add; integral_div; he; hA; hlaw

steps.title: Derive integrability and partition preservation from probability
steps.text: The true smoothed pushforward is a probability measure. Evaluating its withDensity identification on the whole space gives lintegral ofReal(A_eta/Z_V)=1. Its continuous nonnegative density and this finite mass imply actual Bochner integrability, then ordinary integral(A_eta/Z_V)=1. Multiplication by positive Z_V gives integrability of A_eta and integral A_eta=Z_V.
steps.lean: Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map; withDensity_apply; lintegral_ofReal_ne_top_iff_integrable; ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal; hiD; hIntD; hiA; hIntA

steps.title: Identify the actual source Gibbs law
steps.text: Everywhere positivity gives exp(-V_eta)=A_eta exactly. Insert the derived integral A_eta=Z_V into the definition of exponential tilt: the actual Gaussian-smoothed law is precisely volume.tilted(-V_eta), with no supplied Gibbs or normalizer witness.

steps.title: Preserve the source potential convention and derive C2
steps.text: Real log_div at positive A_eta and Z_V gives the exact additive constant U_eta=V_eta+log Z_V. The shared theorem already proved C2 of U_eta; subtraction of the fixed log Z_V therefore proves C2 of the actual source V_eta. The potentials are not asserted literally equal. Neither this constant identity nor C2 proves the source score/covariance or Hessian inequalities.
